correctness.rationale: The sixteen-state condition checks precisely every absent central vertex against its two horizontal and one vertical neighbors (zero dummy neighbors at open ends). Each selected subset has one weighted path. Symbolic inverse and exact characteristic identity in verify.py prove the stated N/D generating function for all rung counts. A unique simple pole, strictly dominant at z=1, with nonzero residue yields the analytic quasi-powers expansion; implicit derivatives give mu, sigma^2>0 and the nonzero beta. Distinct-weight loops on the primitive communicating component rule out degeneracy. Independent graph-based exhaustion checks all subsets for n=1..8, while finite tests are not substituted for the infinite proof.

Neither the scalar evaluation F_n(1) nor cyclic traces uniquely determine the open-end bivariate numerator or the nonzero boundary correction. value.rationale: A full cardinality enumerator supplies previously unstated coefficients for every member of a natural infinite family whose scalar totals were of sufficient interest to be tabulated since 2013. The exact finite-boundary correction and nondegenerate Gaussian law add interpretable size statistics unavailable from scalar totals and isolate a genuine endpoint effect. The result is not a mere recomputation of the OEIS sequence or of the cyclic-prism case; the object and invariant and necessary boundary contraction are explicit. The limited width and closely related transfer literature restrict but do not negate this value.
